newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech equity market downtrend gathers pace.
newsitem.headline: Czech equity market downtrend gathers pace.

text.p: The Czech PX50 and RPIX indices dropped sharply on Wednesday with major issues falling hard and dealers seeing further gloom in the foreseeable future.
The PX50 index dropped 10.2 to 507.7 while the major issue dominated RPIX plunged 28 points to 1,023.
Komercni Banka and SPT Telecom were the biggest decliners among the major issues. Komercni lost 106 crowns to 2,039 and SPT Telecom fell 105 crowns to 2,885.

Dealers said SPT, the most heavily capitalised issue on the Prague bourse, was falling in line with the general decline in confidence in the Czech equity market as a whole rather than because of company fundamentals.
"The whole market has no support whatsoever. There are no fundamental changes to SPT," said Jan Sykora of Wood & Company.
Sykora said the market "could easily go down another five or 10 or 15 percent," and suggested that SPT could follow the market down.
However, he added, the fall of Komercni had been exacerbated by investors' worries about the bank's nine-month results which are due to be released on Friday.
"The nine-month results according to our figures are lower than expected, and the market appears to be reacting to this," he said.
